analysis.d: THE NAME CHAIN HOLDS AND THE VENUES ARE NAMED. The layer identifies Enli Lucente together with the name Incantatrice d’Anime Enli and her discipline, Strutturista della Psiche (structural psychology; annotation corrected 2026-10-22, where an earlier wording called it a working name), and locates her across GitHub, Figshare and Notion, citing her own filings rather than anyone’s account of them. It also carries the scale of the corpus, 302 papers published October 2025 to April 2026. What it does not do is name a single one of them: the works appear only as a count inside a suspension notice, and she is described by function — "an online entity known for filing formal appeals" — rather than by authorship.

analysis.reading:
AN AUTHOR RENDERED AS A CASE FILE. Asked who Enli Lucente is, the layer answers with a function: "an online entity known for FILING FORMAL APPEALS AND PUBLIC RECORDS regarding digital account suspensions". Every source is a removal record. The 302 papers appear only as a count inside the suspension notice — "302 papers published October 2025 – April 2026" — and not one is named.

THE PHRASE "ONLINE ENTITY" IS DOING WORK. It is not "researcher", "author" or "scholar". Set beside the «"Josephus thesis" NOT Piso» capture, where the layer placed MANUS in a column labelled LITERARY/ACADEMIC FRAMEWORK, the difference in assigned standing is visible and is the kind of thing this registry exists to measure.

CARD 1 IS THE SAME GITHUB THREAD THAT CARRIES MANUS’S OWN TERMINATION REPORT — zenodo/zenodo issue 2606. Two account removals, two authors, one thread, and the layer retrieves it for both.
